\\
The ionic model is integrated over the first half of the time interval:
\begin{equation}
\label{step1}
\begin{cases}
C_m \mathrm{M} \dfrac{d\mathbf{v}}{dt} + \mathrm{M} I_{\mathrm{ion}}(\mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w}, \mathbf{c}) = 0, \\[8pt]
\dfrac{d\mathbf{w}}{dt} = \mathbf{W}(\mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w}, \mathbf{c}), \\
\dfrac{d\mathbf{c}}{dt} = \mathbf{C}(\mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w}, \mathbf{c}),
\end{cases}
\qquad t \in \left[t_n, t_n + \tfrac{\Delta t}{2}\right].
\end{equation}
Denoting by $\mathbf{v}^{*}, \mathbf{w}^{*}, \mathbf{c}^{*}$ the discrete quantities
